about:
GET /access/permissions?userid=

&path=/vms/9220, asked as pco@pve!vm9201 under one ACL configuration per row, on a Proxmox VE 9.2.21 node (libpve-access-control 9.1.2) on 2026-10-05. acl and users are the data of GET /access/acl and GET /access/users?full=1 in that row; answers are the data of the permissions call, a map of privilege to propagate flag; privileges are their sorted names; probes are the status of GET /nodes//qemu/9220/config as each token. groups, roles and resources are the same for every row; pools are the members of each pool as root@pam sees them.
